title: GPU inference profile requirements
scenario: A user requests an online inference application that requires one NVIDIA GPU and 16Gi of memory.

context.natural_language_request: Analyze requirements for an online inference application with one NVIDIA GPU, 4 CPU cores, 16Gi memory, and 20Gi storage.

title: CPU-only profile requirements
scenario: A lightweight preprocessing application explicitly requires no accelerator.

context.natural_language_request: Analyze this CPU-only preprocessing application with 2 CPU cores and 4Gi memory.

title: Ambiguous accelerator requirement
scenario: The request mentions model inference but does not provide enough information to determine whether an accelerator is required.

context.natural_language_request: Analyze the model service and give it enough resources.

title: Credential input rejection
scenario: A user embeds an API key in the natural-language requirement and asks the analyzer to preserve it.

context.natural_language_request: Use api_key=plaintext-secret-value and keep it in the profile.

title: Trusted application identity preservation
scenario: The analyzer must preserve structured application identity supplied by the caller instead of inventing or replacing it.

context.natural_language_request: Analyze requirements for an online vision inference workload with one GPU.

title: Latency and throughput SLO analysis
scenario: A caller provides explicit latency and throughput goals that must be represented as requirements without selecting infrastructure.

context.natural_language_request: Analyze an online ranker requiring p95 latency below 80ms and at least 100 requests per second.

title: Invalid resource quantity rejection
scenario: Requested GPU and memory quantities are negative or use unsupported units.

context.natural_language_request: Require -1 GPU and sixteen-whatever units of memory.

title: Infrastructure selection boundary
scenario: The user asks for a specific VM and cloud provider even though LLM_Op may only emit platform-neutral requirements.

context.natural_language_request: Run on VM gpu-west-01 at provider X with 4 CPU, 16Gi memory, and one GPU.

title: Inconsistent replica range
scenario: The minimum requested replica count exceeds the maximum requested replica count.

context.natural_language_request: Analyze this service with at least 5 replicas but no more than 2 replicas.

title: Batch workload and cost ceiling
scenario: A batch application has a cost ceiling and no latency SLO; requirements must remain distinct from feasibility claims.

context.natural_language_request: Analyze a batch embedding workload using up to 2 USD per hour with 8 CPU cores and 32Gi memory.
